trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is no extra task of its own. Plan around A Long Road, the 100% checklist, because that is the longest grind; everything else falls out of the story and the side content. PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours at difficulty 4 out of 10, in a single playthrough with no online trophies.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it unlocks in the first minutes of Chapter 1 — you cannot miss it. Just play through the opening and the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is one of the 12 story trophies, all of which unlock automatically as the missions finish.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The story runs five chapters and each chapter's end carries its own trophy. Before the chapter closes, do Lucia's balcony meditation at home — PowerPyx flags it as the one spot that may be needed for Positive Mental Attitude and that disappears after Chapter 1.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. This is the chapter where Jason and Lucia become playable together, which opens the partner trophies and the last meditation spots. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter — there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Yasmani's jobs in this chapter hand you the Snap Gun, which the Sneakthief trophy needs for a jewelry store's back door, so take the side work as it appears rather than rushing the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. An optional mission in this chapter opens the bank vaults for Maximum Withdrawal, so accept it when it appears — the vaults stay open afterwards and you will need five of the eight.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. It is the only hidden gold and the last story trophy; after the credits the game returns you to free roam, so nothing after the story is locked away. Save manually before the final mission, since there is no replay and no New Game Plus.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Like every story trophy it unlocks automatically when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed — just keep playing the story.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 achievements and trophies list

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. Story trophies unlock as you play the missions — no extra objective is needed, and none of the 12 can be missed.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 achievements and trophies list

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 mission. It pops at the mission's end, automatically, like the rest of the story set.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 achievements and trophies list

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 mission. Another automatic story unlock — finish the mission and the trophy follows.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 achievements and trophies list

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 mission. The name gives the setting away — Vice City International Airport — but the trophy itself only needs the mission finished.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 achievements and trophies list

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 mission. It is the last of the named-mission story trophies before the finale, and it unlocks automatically.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 achievements and trophies list

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the checklist at Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, which opens after the story — earlier progress already counts. The bar is lenient: PowerPyx puts it near 60% of true completion, needing 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons and 70 of 80 challenges. Expect about 100 hours of cleanup after the 60 to 80 hour story; it is the hardest trophy and the last one most hunters earn.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and air time all feed the count. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep chaining stunts while you travel instead of saving them for a grind. Any vehicle works, and the count is cumulative across the whole run.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The activities are the side diversions scattered around Leonida — racing, fishing, shooting ranges, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest. One try each is enough; you do not need to win or finish any of them for this trophy.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. Gold means beating each challenge's top time or score, so learn the layout and retry until the gold threshold clears. Ranges are open from early on, so chip away at them between story missions instead of leaving all 42 for the end.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants all 42 races won. Drone races are flying time trials — cut corners through the gates and keep the drone low to hold speed.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. Winning the same race twice does not count, so work through the list and tick each new one off. Races open up as you explore Leonida's circuits, on road and off.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the spot with a purple icon — go to it and take the challenge. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so the attempt also feeds Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Arcades are found around Vice City — walk up to a cabinet, start a game and see it through to the end. Any game counts, so pick the shortest one you like.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is one of the side-character quest lines; follow his missions until the last one and finish it. Side strands stay open after the story, so this is step 3 cleanup work.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand runs through his missions until the finale — take each job as it appears and the trophy pops at the last one.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, and they stay open after the story, so you can finish them in cleanup. Do all five in order and the finale unlocks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only some strangers count toward the eight: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not — so do not waste the count on the wrong ones. Strangers & Freaks is not part of the 100% checklist, so it needs its own pass in step 3.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand ends with this mission; follow his jobs to the last one. Like the other character finales, it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is separate from the Strangers & Freaks count, so finish his missions in their own time — the finale is the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 meditation spots across Leonida, in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. This is the only trophy PowerPyx flags as possibly missable: the first spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter, and nobody has confirmed whether the trophy needs it — so do it to be safe. The last spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so the missable one cannot cost you A Long Road.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His hunting quests start after Chapter 2 and are Jason-only; the exact animal is not confirmed yet at launch, so follow Bret's quests as they appear and take the hunt when it is offered. Hunting also feeds the 100-animal study count for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of 18. Cards are hidden around Leonida — check shops, interiors and out-of-the-way corners, and tick them off in the tracker as you find them. Any three full sets count.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Any mix counts: Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags. WAiNK It is the in-game photo-tagging activity — point it at a landmark, curiosity or sculpture and tag it. Work through the map region by region so you do not lose track.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70, so you will pass 50 on the way there. Challenges are the small feats scattered through play — stunts, combat, driving and exploration — and the checklist lets you skip the hardest ten.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get four stars with Jason and Lucia together, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level drops. A fast car and the back roads out of Vice City help; your partner must be with you when the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in one run with your partner beside you, keeping the wanted level alive the whole time. Plan a short route between three nearby shops and a getaway car before you start.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so scan every new vehicle you see — the log keeps it once and the count sticks. Traffic in Vice City gives you most of them for free if you scan as you drive.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus first, then trigger it in a fight with a group — an assault rifle makes the five quick. Story firefights give you plenty of chances, so do not force it in free roam.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding gate, take off and get about 1 km away. Enter the airport, grab the jet before security closes in, and climb away from the runway — distance, not altitude, is what counts.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. The base is guarded, so go in fast, grab the Rhino and use its cannon on the soldiers closing in. You do not need to survive long — the kills inside the tank are the trophy.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs give you the Snap Gun for the back door — use it, keep quiet, and take the goods without tripping the alarm. Go at night and stay out of the guards' sightlines.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape, out of 8. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission and always bring 4 stars, so have a fast bike ready for the getaway. You only need five of the eight, but the 100% checklist wants all of them.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open and get away clean. A bank vault job counts too if you get away, so this can pop while you work on Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. Clear the fog from the whole map; a plane is fastest, sweeping the Keys, the swamps and the north in a few passes. Drive or fly through each named area once and the map fills in.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one per gang, 9 gangs. Gang operations are the side robberies marked around Leonida; hit one for each gang and the trophy pops. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so keep going after the trophy.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is unconfirmed at launch — neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned it down yet — but the description points to a specific bar or spot on Ocean Beach. Try the beachfront bars at sunset and watch for a prompt; this guide will be updated as players crack it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The trigger is unconfirmed at launch, but the description points to driving out through a showroom window — find a dealership, get a car to the glass, and drive out through it. This guide will be updated once players confirm the exact spot.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The way to do it is to rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police. It is a gang operation with a bowling twist, not a game of bowling itself.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia — working out together trains both at once. Gyms and training spots around Leonida raise Strength; keep at it until both bars are full.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — the running count of things you do that shift how Leonida sees you. Do not push toward the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent. Spread your choices and check the profile as you go.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The exact trigger is unconfirmed at launch — neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned it down yet. The name suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something, so if a fail-and-retry moment comes up, take the second try seriously. This guide will be updated as players crack it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The exact trigger is unconfirmed at launch. The name points to something strange — a UFO, a cryptid, an odd encounter somewhere in Leonida. Keep an eye out in the swamps and the Keys, and this guide will be updated once players find it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The exact trigger is unconfirmed at launch, but the name says it: knock people down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Try a drive-by with a bat from a slow car through a crowd and watch for the pop.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. It is a running total, and Yasmani pays the most, so route your marked bills through him. Marked bills come from robberies and gang operations — launder as you earn and the total climbs.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, as a running total. Buy weapons, clothes, food and gear as you play and the total adds up on its own. Big purchases — cars and properties — count too, so this usually pops during the story without a dedicated grind.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: the 8 for sale, about $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count, so buy the eight listed for sale. Save up during the story — by the end you will have the cash, and each garage also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which Moses gives you in Chapter 2. You need free garage space for each one, so buy the garages for Little Boxes first if you are full. Register a mix of cars and bikes you find around Leonida.
